semantics.market_value_base: absolute gross exposure in account base currency; null when base currency is unavailable
semantics.weight_pct: percent of account gross base exposure; null when base currency is unavailable
semantics.base_currency: account base currency or null when unavailable; never inferred from position currency
semantics.currency_warning: explanation when base currency is unavailable; null for known currency
semantics.estimated: true when currency or FX is missing or uses fallback
semantics.account: opaque account identifier; retain per-row attribution

not_covered: order and option routes currently return markdown
session-aware prices and day P&L require the downstream price-stream contract
